newsitem.title: USA: Total Containment names Desjardins CEO.
newsitem.headline: Total Containment names Desjardins CEO.

text.p: Total Containment Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors named Pierre Desjardins as the company's president and chief executive officer.
It said Marc Guindon, who had been chairman and chief executive officer, would remain as chairman.
Desjardins was president and chief executive officer of Domtar Inc, Canada's second largest pulp and paper, packaging and construction materials company, the company said.

Total Containment makes and distributes underground systems and products for the conveyance and containment of oil- and alcohol-based motor vehicle fuels from underground storage tanks to above-ground fuel dispensers.
